title: Initialization and remainder machine
statement: For a symbol alphabet $\Gamma$, a number $m\in\mathbb N$ of work tapes, source and destination indices $\mathrm{src},\mathrm{dst}\in\mathrm{Fin}(m)$, symbols $\mathrm{zero},\mathrm{one},\mathrm{first},\mathrm{last}\in\Gamma$, and $k\in\mathbb N$, define an $m$-work-tape Turing machine with the initialization-and-remainder state space. It is assembled by composing a machine that writes $[\mathrm{first}]$ on the destination, a forward skip there, the positioning machine, forward skips on the source and destination, the recursive tail machine, and backward skips on the destination interleaved with the clean-template machine.
